Quiz editor

/teach/courses/:courseId/quizzes/:quizId/edit
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S16

Author a versioned quiz with independent availability, due time, timer, attempt selection and result-release policy.

Entry and return
W35 add quizW42 insert questionsW48 assessment settings
Layout regions
Question outlineStable IDs, types, points and bank versions
Question editorPrompt, accessible media, response choices and staff-only key
RulesQuiz-specific window/due/timer, attempts and held result preview
Fields and validation (6)
FieldTypeRequiredValidationDefaultVisible to
Questions/keytyped question listYesSingle-choice, multiple-select, numeric or written response; stable IDs; finite positive points. Choice keys valid; multiple-select all-or-nothing by default; numeric key/tolerance finite with tolerance ≥0; written response requires human review.—Authorised staff
Availability and duedatetimesYesOpen ≤ due ≤ close; entirely independent of assignment dates—Authorised staff
Timer minutesintegerNoOptional base1-1440 minute reviewable bound. Effective duration uses exactly one allowance mode: added minutes OR positive multiplier. Hard personal close truncates the timer; leaving/refreshing does not reset elapsed time.—Authorised staff
Attempts and selectioninteger + enumYes1–10 proposed bound; choose highest/latest completed attempt and disclose before start1; latest completedAuthorised staff
Feedback releaseenumYesManual held by default; correct-answer visibility separately controlledHeldAuthorised staff
Integrity noticetextNoDisclose any collected focus/visibility events; no automatic blur cancellation or lockdown claim—Authorised staff

Dialogs and drawers (2)
Change published quiz
  • Question/key/rule diff and active/received attempt counts
  • Existing question-answer snapshots preserved; score correction enters held review
Return without applying changesPublish eligible future version
Unsaved changes
  • Name the current draft and changed fields; show save destination and whether sample storage is available.
  • Discard restores the last saved draft, never deletes received work or published history.
Keep editingSave draft and return, or explicitly discard changes
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Assignment due/close edits never change quiz timing or feedback release.
  • Window blur never erases or cancels an attempt.
  • A question-key edit after submission cannot rewrite the received snapshot or silently release recalculated results.
  • Saving an incomplete draft preserves entered fields with draft status; publishing/applying remains blocked until consequential validation passes. Cancel keeps published/received history unchanged.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
  • TA authoring is disabled in initial HTML; listed authoring actions require a separately approved future grant.
  • Proposed quiz deadline = earlier of personal close and startedAt + effective duration; untimed quiz ends at personal close. Show a shortened window before Start. Use one timer allowance mode (extra minutes OR multiplier), not both. At expiry finalize only acknowledged answers; unsent offline text remains a recoverable local draft requiring staff review, never a fake accepted receipt.
